description: Draw the repository as a graph, or a cut of it. A host that renders MCP Apps shows the interactive view inline; every other host gets this answer: how many roots, cards and edges, the cut asked for, a Mermaid diagram when it fits (else a table of roots with card counts), and a link to the running behold serve at that view. The answer holds no document JSON, and no card list when the diagram does not fit. For a big estate ask again with around, a root or card id from the table, to see one part. Reads the files and git objects in this process; it needs no serve and no chant search. dir is a folder inside the project (default: the project). around takes comma-separated card or box ids and cuts to them and what is within depth hops (default 1); direction up follows what they depend on, down what depends on them. changed takes <base>..<head> (or <base>...<head> from the merge base) and cuts to what changed between the two commits, each card marked added, removed, changed or neighbour. around and changed are two cuts: give one.

around.description: Comma-separated card or box ids to cut around (a root such as a Terraform root, or a card id from the roots table), with what is within depth hops of them.

changed.description: A revision range, <base>..<head> or <base>...<head> (from the merge base): cut to what changed between the two commits and the cards within depth hops.

depth.description: Hops from the cards around names, or from what changed (default 1).

dir.description: A folder inside the project to read, relative to it (default: the project folder).

direction.description: With around: up follows what the cards depend on, down what depends on them (default both).

name: graph
